aboutHero.description: Duhuze RSVP was born from a simple frustration: organizing events in Africa meant juggling spreadsheets, scattered WhatsApp chats, and manual headcounts. We built the tool we wished existed.

storyVision.storyP1: We started Duhuze RSVP after watching a friend spend three days chasing RSVPs across five WhatsApp groups, two shared spreadsheets, and a notebook that kept getting misplaced.
storyVision.storyP2: That chaos is familiar to anyone who has planned an event in Africa. The tools that exist were built for different contexts — different networks, different devices, different expectations.
storyVision.storyP3: So we built something that actually fits: lightweight, mobile-first, and designed for the way events here really work.
storyVision.visionQuote: Every celebration — from intimate dinners to 500-guest weddings — deserves a calm, organized experience. We give organizers a single source of truth so they can focus on what matters: the people.
